text:
A balloon is charged by rubbing it with a cloth.
When a negatively charged plastic rod is held close to the charged balloon, the rod and
balloon attract.
Which statement is correct?
A
The balloon lost electrons to the cloth.
B
The balloon gained electrons from the cloth.
C
The balloon lost protons to the cloth.
D
The balloon gained protons from the cloth.

options.label: A
options.text: The balloon lost electrons to the cloth.

options.label: B
options.text: The balloon gained electrons from the cloth.

options.label: C
options.text: The balloon lost protons to the cloth.

options.label: D
options.text: The balloon gained protons from the cloth.
